build.buildCommand: pip install --upgrade pip && pip install -r requirements.txt && python ecom/manage.py collectstatic --noinput

deploy.startCommand: cd /app/ecom && while ! python manage.py dbshell --command='SELECT 1;' >/dev/null 2>&1; do echo 'Waiting for database...'; sleep 5; done && python manage.py migrate --noinput && gunicorn ecom.wsgi:application --bind 0.0.0.0:$PORT --timeout 120 --workers 2
